title: ESP32S3 cluster running 1.58-bit (BitNet) Language model
summary: A distributed computing project that runs a 1.58-bit quantized BitNet language model across a cluster of ESP32S3 microcontrollers, demonstrating how aggressive quantization enables AI inference on extremely resource-constrained hardware typically used for IoT devices.
problem_solved: Enables running large language model inference on cheap, low-power microcontrollers with severe memory and compute limitations.
why_valuable: Demonstrates the feasibility of deploying AI models on sub-$10 hardware, potentially democratizing AI access for edge and IoT applications.
